title: Backdated Effective Dates on Termination
content:
# Backdated Effective Dates on Termination

When a Kessler GAP waiver under the Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda is terminated after the lienholder reports the loan paid off or refinanced away, the termination may take effect earlier than the loan payoff date, with a backdating credit added to the refund.

## The replacement purchase

The holder's replacement purchase is the holder's most recently signed group purchase deal under the Vehicle Purchase Agreements: the deal whose vehicle price was charged last (of two charged on the same day, the one recorded first), where that deal stands in contracted status. A latest deal in any other status means there is no replacement purchase. Its trade-in is its trade-in allowance; it carries a trade-in when that allowance is above 0.00. Its signing date is its contract date.

## The dating rule

| Situation on the records | Effective date of the termination | Backdating credit |
|---|---|---|
| The loan payoff date falls within the free-look period of the waiver's tier (30 calendar days after the sale date on Kessler GAP Waiver 125, Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140 and Kessler GAP Commercial 130; 60 on Kessler GAP Waiver 150, Kessler GAP Plus 150 and Kessler GAP Plus 175) | The sale date | The waiver's price times the calendar days from the sale date to the loan payoff date, divided by the calendar days from the sale date to the expiration date |
| Not within the free look, and the replacement purchase carries a trade-in and was signed on or before the loan payoff date and no more than 30 calendar days before it | The replacement purchase's contract date | The waiver's price times the calendar days from that contract date to the loan payoff date, divided by the calendar days from the sale date to the expiration date |
| Every other case | The loan payoff date | None |

The backdating credit is rounded half up to the cent on its own and is added to the refund after the unused-share amount has been rounded. Calendar days are counted from the earlier date (day 0); a payoff on the last day of the free-look period is within it, and a replacement purchase signed exactly 30 calendar days before the payoff date is within the window, 31 days before is not. A replacement purchase signed after the loan payoff date does not move the date.

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

Waiver price 681.00, 1,826 calendar days from sale to expiration, outside the free look.

- Replacement purchase with a trade-in signed 14 days before the payoff: effective on that contract date; credit 681.00 times 14 divided by 1,826, which is 5.2212..., rounded to 5.22.
- Same purchase signed 25 days before: credit 9.3237..., rounded to 9.32.
- Same purchase without a trade-in, or signed 31 days before: effective on the payoff date, no credit.
